text:
𝗜𝗡𝗗𝗜𝗔 𝗖𝗛𝗔𝗦𝗘 𝟯𝟯𝟴! 🇮🇳

Pakistan U19 finish on 337/9 in the Asia Cup final; Usman Khan 107, Qadir 80 off 54.
India are 16/0 after 3.3 overs, 322 more needed.

Can they chase it? 👇

#U19AsiaCup #INDvPAK

facebook.caption:
𝗜𝗡𝗗𝗜𝗔 𝗞𝗘 𝗟𝗜𝗬𝗘 𝟯𝟯𝟴 𝗞𝗔 𝗧𝗔𝗥𝗚𝗘𝗧! 🇮🇳🔥

👉 U19 Asia Cup final mein Pakistan ne 50 over mein 337/9 banaye
👉 Usman Khan ka 107 aur Abdul Qadir ke 54 gend mein 80
👉 India ki chase shuru: 3.3 over mein 16/0, jeetne ko 322 run aur chahiye

Kya India chase kar payega? Comment karo 👇

#CricketKiBaat #U19AsiaCup #INDvPAK
